name: Isagi de Tiaojiu Riji
source:
This fan game, set in a VA-11 HALL-A alternate universe and centered around the "Isagi x Bachira" pairing from Blue Lock, tells the story of bartender Isagi returning to work at Blue Lock after a three-month leave of absence...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4167230]Steam[/url]]
